**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **§ 28.1** — New York law, with conflict-of-laws and CISG expressly excluded. This is the preferred playbook position.
- **§ 28.2** — Exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts of New York County, with irrevocable submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue/forum objections. Also preserves either party's ability (including ours) to seek temporary injunctive relief in another court to protect confidential information or IP — a useful mutual carve-out.
- **Arbitration** — A document-wide search returned no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration concern and no walk-away trigger.
- **§ 28.3** (per the planner hint) — The pre-suit executive escalation is mutual and 15 business days, and it expressly "does not delay urgent relief or a filing needed to preserve a limitations period." It therefore does not gate injunctive relief or risk a limitations lapse, so no amendment is warranted.
